head_coach.name: Hossam Hassan
head_coach.play_style_summary: Hassan prioritizes a compact, disciplined defensive shape combined with rapid vertical transitions. The system relies on winning the ball quickly in midfield and exploiting the pace of wide attackers on counter-attacks.

key_players.name: Omar Marmoush
key_players.performance_stats: Scored 3 goals and provided 3 assists in 20 Premier League matches for Manchester City, serving as a highly anticipated offensive focal point.

key_players.name: Mohamed Salah
key_players.performance_stats: Netted 12 goals and registered 9 assists across 39 appearances for Liverpool in his final season, serving as the Pharaohs' captain and legendary talisman.

key_players.name: Trezeguet (Mahmoud Hassan)
key_players.performance_stats: Plays for Al Ahly where he is the Egyptian Premier League's most valuable player; crucial to the national team's width and transition play.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Cruciate ligament injury (knee medial ligament tear) ruling him out of the 2026 World Cup.
Muscle injury sidelined the experienced goalkeeper ahead of the training camp.
Suffered a hamstring tear in late April 2026; though sidelined for several weeks, he is undergoing intensive treatment to recover in time for the World Cup.
